title: Value of the last vertex
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $gs$ be a list of gates, and let $g$ be a gate. For any Boolean assignment $x$ to the $n$ inputs, the value at vertex $n+|gs|$ after applying $gs$ followed by $g$ equals the evaluation of $g$ on the vertex values obtained by applying $gs$ to $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
